posts.post:
a belt either pulls an outfit together or ruins the line completely.

there is no middle ground.

the most exhausting part of menswear is the obsession with 'versatility.'

sometimes a piece should just do one thing perfectly.

people say you should dress for the job you want.

i’ve always found that the best way to get nothing done.

we finally settled on the hem weight for the new knitwear.

it feels like a paperweight, exactly how i wanted it.
